name: Holcim Ltd
tagline: A global leader in innovative and sustainable building solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: Holcim atteint une marge EBIT récurrente record de 18,1% sur 12 mois glissants au Q1 2026, leader de l'industrie. Cette performance reflète l'excellence opérationnelle, la discipline sur les coûts, la montée en gamme du portefeuille avec les produits durables et la réduction de l'exposition aux coûts énergétiques grâce aux combustibles alternatifs.

kpis.explanation: Marge bénéficiaire opérationnelle récurrente calculée sur 12 mois glissants, hors éléments exceptionnels.
kpis.signal: Marge leader de l'industrie en expansion continue
kpis.description: La marge EBIT récurrente atteint 18,1% sur 12 mois glissants au Q1 2026, en progression de 40 points de base, confirmant le leadership de Holcim dans l'industrie des matériaux de construction.
kpis._validation: Changed from 18% to 18.1%; YoY recalculated from +0.9pts to +40bps (18.1% vs 17.7%); History updated with actual 12M rolling data from source (Q1 2024: 17.0%, Q1 2025: 17.7%, Q1 2026: 18.1%); Last_data_date corrected to 2026-04-24; Promoted to hero_kpi as it represents industry-leading performance explicitly highlighted in source

kpis.explanation: Revenu total généré par l'entreprise au premier trimestre.

kpis.explanation: Ratio de l'énergie thermique issue de combustibles alternatifs sur l'énergie thermique totale consommée dans les fours à ciment en Europe.
kpis.signal: Protection accrue contre la volatilité des prix de l'énergie
kpis.description: Le taux d'utilisation de combustibles alternatifs en Europe atteint 70% au Q1 2026, protégeant Holcim de l'exposition aux prix de l'énergie et soutenant l'objectif de 90% en Europe d'ici 2030.
kpis._validation: New KPI added from source (page 4 & 9); Value 70% explicitly stated for Europe Q1 2026; Strategic importance emphasized for cost reduction and decarbonization; History short but represents current achievement toward 90% 2030 target

kpis.explanation: Part des coûts de carburants et d'électricité dans le chiffre d'affaires.

company_description: Holcim AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides building materials and solutions in Europe, Latin America, and Asia, Middle East, and Africa. It provides foundation, flooring, walling and roofing products, including cement, clinker, and other cementitious materials; ready-mix concrete; aggregates, such as crushed stone, gravel, and sand; and precast, concrete products, asphalts, mortars, roofing systems, insulation systems, tile adhesives, facade solutions, and contracting and services. The company also provides digital services through HOLCIM+ platform and digital concrete services. Its products are used in infrastructure projects, such as tunnels, railways and train stations, airports and ports, and bridges; housing projects, including individual and collective housing; commercial projects comprising offices, retail, and public buildings; and industrial projects consisting of renewable energy, oil and gas, and mining. The company sells its products under the ECOPact, ECOPlanet, Aggneo, Hydromedia, ZinCo Holcim, Elevate, Airium, PRB Group, Cantillana, Flachdach Technologie, Izolbet, Disensa, Tector, DYNAMax, Agilia, Ductal, Artevia, Humes, Tensolite, Compaktuna, and other serv
